maya: FYI I'm hitting a weird issue in the Node sampleapp: when the OAuth refresh flow triggers a retry the X-Request-ID disappears from subsequent backend logs. makes tracing the refresh path impossible. :grimacing:

sam_chang: staging only or repro-able in prod? any minimal repro steps? :mag:

maya: staging. repro: call /protected with expired token -> auth middleware does refresh -> it retries original request. initial request has x-request-id in headers, retry does not.

ben-ops: that smells like propagation getting dropped. our otel propagator and logging hook order is sensitive. if retry is created outside the current async context the propagated headers won't be attached.

ciara_reliability: what sampleapp version and which retry lib? is it axios-retry or a custom retry wrapper?

maya: node sampleapp v0.9.3, axios-retry. incoming headers show `x-request-id: req-1234`. but outgoing retry request headers logged as only `authorization` after refresh.

maya: logs snippet:
INFO auth: incoming headers {"authorization":"Bearer abc...","x-request-id":"req-1234"}
WARN auth: token expired, doing refresh
DEBUG http: outgoing retry headers {"authorization":"Bearer def..."}
INFO proxy: handled /api/data without req_id

sam_chang: two leads: 1) check that otel/framework propagator is attached before logging middleware; 2) ensure retry uses current context or explicitly copies req-id into retry requests.

ben-ops: ordering matters. typical express ordering: `app.use(otelMiddleware)` then `app.use(loggingMiddleware)`. if the retry logic spins off a fresh axios request outside that context, headers are lost.

ciara_reliability: short-term mitigation: add an axios request interceptor that injects x-request-id from our context into every outgoing request (covers retries). example snippet:
```js
axios.interceptors.request.use(cfg => {
  const id = logging.getReqIdFromContext();
  if (id) cfg.headers['x-request-id'] = id;
  return cfg;
});
```

maya: that helped in local testing. however we ran into a separate redaction problem: our header redactor strips auth tokens but sometimes rewrites the header blob and accidentally drops non-sensitive headers like x-request-id when Authorization is redacted. filed a bug for the redactor logic.

sam_chang: so two fixes: propagate req-id into retries, and make redactor preserve unrelated headers. can you open PRs for both (sampleapp interceptor + redaction patch)?

maya: yes. PRs incoming. sampleapp PR adds interceptor + unit/integration test asserting x-request-id survives oauth refresh. redactor PR changes redaction to operate on header map instead of collapsing into a single string, preserving keys that don't match sensitive patterns.

ciara_reliability: add an integration test in CI that spins up the oauth refresh path and validates logs/traces still contain the same req id after retry. also add a brief doc in devex-sdks: "Retry-aware propagation" for Node SDK and sampleapp.

maya: will add tests + docs. adding a runtime flag `FORCE_PROPAGATE_REQID=true` to enable the interceptor as a temporary staging workaround. noting it in the runbook. :memo:
